reviews.review:
A nice romp thru the daily life of a Space Marine.  For game play it is a third person shooter with gore.  

Other then that Kinda expensive for the price.  They gave it away for free, and that boosted multiplayer.  However still small.  Also still glitchy as hell.  Will not break your game, but an issue will pop up and will bother you, or just go away when you restart.

As for why you should get this game, it is to play a day in the life of a space marine.  About it, so unless you are a big fan boy, nothing to see here now.  Cause all the people involved ended up in financial trouble, so paying now aint going magic up a sequel.

Only reason I say no is it is 8+ years old, it was given away from free, it has not been updated in a while, and yet they want 30 dollars.
For the love of all that is holy, PLEASE MAKE A SEQUEL!!!!

Awesome game. Good W40K atmosphere, you "feel" that your hero weights much, you "feel" that weaponry SM using are fricking heavy and deadly. Graphics didnt get old that much, sound is awesome. Back old days when I bought this game on premiere Multiplayer was fun but now its mostly for veterans and highly skilled players. MP also have hard horde-mode called Extermianatus its very fun and enjoyng. 
Cons? Almost none. Had only problem with mouse speed and cracking sound. For me solution was to clean up PC from dust and disable v-synch in-game while enabling it in graphic card display manager for W40K: Space Marine as well as turning on Tripple Buffering.

This game has awful controls, only 4 guns, and is a total bore. They give you a jetpack 30 minutes in, which help with the world's worst movement, then take it away 15 minutes later.

Also you don't get to control the titan.

*Edit:* I've been told there are more than 4 guns, I was probably wrong about that. I couldn't get more than 2 hours in. Everything else holds true.
